description: This header defines classes and interfaces for socket implementations, including various socket types (Raw, UDP, TCP, UDS, Netlink), address classes, and socket connection handling within the beerocks::net namespace. It provides abstractions for socket operations such as bind, listen, accept, connect, send, and receive, with support for different socket address types and socket options.

classes.name: SocketAbstractImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class for all socket types, managing a file descriptor and socket options.

classes.name: UdsAddress
classes.description: Represents a Unix Domain Socket address with path and related utilities.

classes.name: InternetAddress
classes.description: Represents an IPv4 internet socket address with port, IP, and name.

classes.name: LinkLevelAddress
classes.description: Represents a link-layer socket address with interface index and MAC address.

classes.name: NetlinkAddress
classes.description: Represents a netlink socket address with groups and name.

classes.name: ConnectedSocket
classes.description: Wrapper for socket file descriptor obtained via accept().

classes.name: UdsSocket
classes.description: Unix Domain Socket implementation with configurable type.

classes.name: SocketConnectionImpl
classes.description: Implements socket connection interface for sending/receiving data.

classes.name: ServerSocketAbstractImpl
classes.description: Abstract server socket class with bind, listen, accept.

classes.name: ClientSocketAbstractImpl
classes.description: Abstract client socket class with bind and connect.

classes.name: UdsServerSocket
classes.description: Factory for UDS server socket, including creation, bind, listen.

classes.name: TcpServerSocket
classes.description: Factory for TCP server socket, including creation, bind, listen.

methods.name: create_instance
methods.description: Creates socket address instances or server sockets.
